name: Tasks-md
description: A kanban board that keeps every card as a Markdown file

paths.name: Tasks
paths.description: Your boards: one folder per lane and one Markdown file per card. Back it up.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Your theme (custom.css), card images and the sort order.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Tasks.md board, published on host as 7003

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: TITLE
variables.description: A name shown under the header and in the browser tab. Leave blank for none.
